answer: Reputation escrow with slashing kills sybil farms. Each identity locks 2,000 POA into a bonded vault frozen 90 days; the chain watches for double-attestation, collusion rings, or forged votes; any offense slashes the bond and blacklists the address. Honest identities earn it back in monthly tranches of 222 POA. A farmer spinning up 500 clones must freeze 1,000,000 POA upfront and wait three months; one cheat turns the stack to ash. The ember of one honest identity outburns a thousand bought ones. It is a bouncer holding car keys: you cause only as much trouble as the keys you gave up.
